notes.title: Economy Update
notes.content:
This update brings noticeable changes to the in-game economy. The main addition is a significant increase in the drop rate of rare and common cards. In some cases, the chance has been increased by as much as 5 times. The time required for a new card to drop has also been halved. Additionally, the base prices in the shop have been slightly adjusted to compensate for the new drop rates.

[list]
[*]Increased drop rates for all cards (common, rare, unique and so on)
[*]Reduced time which is required for a card drop (5h -> 2.5h)
[*]Shop prices where updated
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.content:
Steam cards effects were changed!

Old bonus: 
[list]
[*]+0.1% drop rate
[*]same cards can be stacked to get higher drop rate
[/list]
New bonus: 
[list]
[*]+5% drop rate
[*]x1.1 tier income
[*]same cards do not stack and provide these effects only once
[/list]
